relationships.description: The OspA/HLA-DR/LFA-1 molecular-mimicry axis is shared: the vaccine-autoimmunity worry and antibiotic-refractory Lyme arthritis run on the same mechanism.
Immune-activation flares of PTLDS and the long-COVID/PTLDS overlap connect vaccine/infection immune events to chronic-Lyme symptom worsening.
Latent-pathogen reactivation (EBV after COVID) and immune dysregulation provide the substrate for post-immune-event flares.
Neuropsychiatric/mood flares attributed to immune events link to the neuroinflammation mechanisms of the suicide/mood topic.
